name: Controlled Graph Geometry / Capacity Decomposition
question: Which structural measure best characterizes the capacity represented by memory size S: state count, relation count, boundary, density, or projection?
principles: Do not equate S with area or volume before testing
Preserve all negative and failed results
Change one controlled factor at a time where possible
Projection must not alter the underlying graph
analysis_plan: Measure which quantities remain invariant under projection
Do not rank measures using post-hoc criteria
success_criteria: A structural measure shows reproducible association with the controlled graph property under independent seeds
The association survives relevant null controls
The result is not explained solely by N_states or N_edges
failure_criteria: No candidate measure adds explanatory value
Results are projection-dependent without corresponding graph change
Simple state/edge count explains all observed variation
